**tuna-fonts 0.2.2**: a small fix and a tidier sidebar. If you have 0.2.1, the app will offer it when you open it.

### Fixed
- **The Ko-fi button in *settings → about* opened a folder** (Documents) instead of your browser. Links are now opened the way Windows expects, so they always go to the browser.

### Tidier
- **Empty categories are hidden** in the sidebar: a category only shows up when you have at least one font in it (or while it's the one selected, so you can clear it).

![The tray menu](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/atunfrito/tuna-fonts/main/docs/tray-menu.gif)

Everything new in 0.2.1 (tray icon with its own menu, open when Windows starts, fonts installed for all users showing up) is in the [0.2.1 notes](https://github.com/atunfrito/tuna-fonts/releases/tag/v0.2.1).

### Downloads
- **`tuna-fonts_0.2.2_x64-setup.exe`**: installer (per user, no admin rights needed). Updates itself.
- **`tuna-fonts_0.2.2_x64-portable.zip`**: portable version; unzip and run `tuna-fonts.exe`.

Windows 10/11, 64-bit. **Not code-signed**, so Windows SmartScreen may warn you the first time: *More info → Run anyway*.

Found a bug? [Open an issue](https://github.com/atunfrito/tuna-fonts/issues/new/choose).

---

**En español:** la 0.2.2 arregla el botón de Ko-fi de *ajustes → acerca de*, que abría la carpeta Documentos en vez del navegador, y esconde las categorías de la barra lateral que no tienen ninguna fuente. Las novedades de la 0.2.1 (bandeja con su menú, abrir al iniciar Windows, fuentes instaladas para todos visibles) están en las [notas de la 0.2.1](https://github.com/atunfrito/tuna-fonts/releases/tag/v0.2.1).
